name: face-ui-react
description: Root Face UI showcase gallery contract for the Render playground.

face.description: Optional gallery face document with visible component cards.

behavior.themeToggle: Local gallery theme toggles an explicit light/dark override on top of the inherited app theme.
behavior.clear: Clears local gallery overrides and returns the showcase to the inherited app theme.

notes: Gallery-only tokens belong to the root face-ui-react showcase component, not to the individual previewed components.
The gallery renders Bar, Text and Button primitives but owns its preview grid, header sizing and component preview surface geometry.
Root background follows the iframe panel surface, while component preview cards use the same overlay surface as navigation/dropdown panels.

whenToUse: Render playground gallery for the Face UI package
whenNotToUse: Application UI outside the Face UI package preview
